The Franz Werfel Stipendium, run by Austria's OeAD agency, invites critics and cultural journalists from abroad for research stays in Austria connected to a journalistic or critical project on Austrian culture. The annual call and its closing date are announced on the OeAD grant page.

Programme Highlights

  • Niche fellowship for critics and cultural journalists worldwide
  • Research stay in Austria with monthly grant support
  • Project-based selection around Austrian culture topics
  • Administered by OeAD, Austria's national mobility agency

Who Should Apply

Established critics and cultural journalists with publications in the field, proposing a concrete project tied to Austrian cultural life.

Funding and Costs

Monthly grant plus accommodation support for the stay in Austria, per the grant conditions.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the OeAD page for the current call, closing date and the required project proposal format. Key deadline information: Annual call — the closing date for the next round is announced on the OeAD grant page.

Official Source

  • Official application page (verified link)

About OeAD (Austria)

OeAD is Austria's agency for education and internationalisation, administering mobility grants and fellowships including the Franz Werfel Stipendium for cultural journalists.

Official website: https://oead.at

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Annual call - see official page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
